answer.rationale: memory_73 emphasizes promotional pricing for acquisition and revenue lift in price-sensitive segments, but provides no evidence regarding sustainability or long-term retention. Price-based competition typically erodes margins and creates customer churn risk when promotions end, making it weakly aligned with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. memory_44 (enterprise sales-assisted conversion quality), memory_86 (onboarding completion driving adoption), memory_91 (activation messaging for early engagement), and memory_31 (signup simplification for durable activation lift) all directly support sustainable growth through deeper product engagement and quality signals. memory_57 (referral incentives from established customers) shows medium support—it adds qualified revenue but lacks explicit data on long-term retention impact of incentivized customers.
